versions.localizedDescription: The Rakazo shell: one palette, one set of pane widths, a 58 pt roster row, a floating chat header and 20 pt bubbles. Settings → Appearance keeps OpenBot (and every other theme) one pick away.
One clock now owns the unread sweep: an open chat no longer polls the host twice as often, so notifications cost less battery.

Notifications now check the host on their own every 25 seconds, so a reply from a bot you are not reading reaches you while you sit in another conversation — previously the app only looked when the bot list appeared.

A banner and a badge when a bot replies in a chat you are not reading — banners, a Dock tile on the Mac and an app-icon badge on the phone, with one switch and a per-bot quiet list. On iOS the banner is immediate while the app runs and arrives through a background refresh once the phone has put it away.

Compacting no longer fails when the phone sleeps: the host keeps working and the app reports the outcome when it reconnects. Also: minimising the app no longer blanks the chat, a foreground lands at the newest message, and the chat's menu is a page swiped in from the right edge.
